newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rise, forint seen down vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rise, forint seen down vs dlr.

text.p: 0648 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates edged up on Friday in tightening money supply, traders said.

* Overnight rates traded between 20.00 and 20.125 percent compared with Thursday's close of 19.75 percent and traders said many banks might have chosen to deposit excess funds with the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility, currently at 20.00 percent.
* The forint was seen opening weaker against the dollar at around 188.90/95, compared with Thursday's close of 188.47/52 but right on the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid).
